simple.summary: רָשַׁשׁ (râshash) means to demolish First listed occurrence: Jer 5 17.

definitions.full: H7567. rashash [ רָשַׁשׁ ] verb Po`el beat down, shatter (Syriac bruise, grind ); — Imperfect 3masculine singular יְרשֵׁשׁ Jer 5:17 one shall beat down thy fortified cities Pu`al Perfect 1plural רֻשּׁשְׁנוּ Mal 1:4 we are beaten down .
